name: cutaway
description: Learn how engines, wings, and machines work with interactive cutaways. Built for ChatGPT using Ryan's /anatomy toolkit.

interface.longDescription:
Look inside a GE9X jet engine, follow water through an espresso machine, compare wing designs, or watch the pistons in a boxer engine. Ask for labels, controls, and explanations of the parts.

Cutaway uses the file and code tools in your ChatGPT session to produce self-contained HTML, SVG drawings, or editable source, without a separate API key. These are teaching models, with simplified shapes, timing, and flow.

The drawing toolkit comes from Ryan's (@wheresryan22) MIT-licensed /anatomy. Optional glow and palettes come from April Zhu's iso-glow, based on Tolga Cohce's iso-figure. Cutaway adapts their work for ChatGPT and keeps the upstream licenses.
defaultPrompt: Build a GE9X cutaway using GE Aerospace references. Show its components, core and bypass airflow, and simplifications.
Build an interactive boxer engine cutaway. Show opposing pistons, connecting rods, and their separate crankpins.
Build a cutaway espresso machine with a pump, boiler, group head, and moving water.
